gltf.loaderRequirement: Configure GLTFLoader.setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder); runtime must support WebP, KHR_mesh_quantization and EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing.

geometryComparison.method: Read GLB JSON accessors. For each TRIANGLES primitive, triangle count is index accessor count / 3 (or POSITION count / 3 for a nonindexed primitive). Unique mesh triangles sum each mesh once. Scene triangles traverse the default scene and multiply a referenced mesh by its EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing accessor count, or one for a regular node.
geometryComparison.interpretation: The web asset uses fewer mesh/primitive/node records and GPU instances. Its expanded scene triangle count equals the original; node counts are not a count of distinct visible objects after merging and instancing.
limitations: The compressed vertex buffers were not decoded for a vertex-by-vertex comparison.
Equal triangle totals do not prove identical topology, vertex positions, normals, UVs, material values or texture pixels.
Mesh quantization and WebP conversion are declared transformations; no bit-identical geometry or texture claim is made.

estimatedDecodedTextureMemory.method: Sum width × height × 4 bytes × 4/3 for RGBA8 and a complete mip chain, decimal MB. This is a texture allocation estimate per separately decoded asset, not measured browser GPU usage or total memory.
